title: Swiss Chard Burekas Cups
subtitle: with kashkaval and ricotta in filo
description: Filo squares pressed into a muffin tin and filled with a blended chard, kashkaval and ricotta mixture, then baked until golden.

steps.text: Cook the chard leaves in a little olive oil until completely soft. Season with salt and pepper and leave to cool. Process in a food processor to a coarse paste.
Grate 100 g of the kashkaval and crumble the ricotta. Mix the chard with the cheeses and adjust the seasoning if needed.
Preheat the oven to 190°C. Brush one filo sheet with olive oil, place a second sheet on top and brush again. Cut the sheets into 15 x 15 cm squares.
Line a muffin tin with the filo squares and fill with the chard and cheese mixture. Fold the edges inwards.
Sprinkle with the remaining 2 tablespoons grated kashkaval and bake until browned.
